text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Oh clap{H8628} your hands,{H3709} all ye peoples;{H5971} Shout{H7321} unto God{H430} with the voice{H6963} of triumph.{H7440}
For Jehovah{H3068} Most High{H5945} is terrible;{H3372} He is a great{H1419} King{H4428} over all the earth.{H776}
He subdueth{H1696} peoples{H5971} under us, And nations{H5971} under our feet.{H7272}
He chooseth{H977} our inheritance{H5159} for us, The glory{H1347} of Jacob{H3290} whom he loved.{H157} Selah{H5542}
God{H430} is gone up{H5927} with a shout,{H8643} Jehovah{H3068} with the sound{H6963} of a trumpet.{H7782}
Sing praise{H2167} to God,{H430} sing praises:{H2167} Sing praises{H2167} unto our King,{H4428} sing praises.{H2167}
For God{H430} is the King{H4428} of all the earth:{H776} Sing ye praises{H2167} with understanding.{H7919}
God{H430} reigneth{H4427} over the nations:{H1471} God{H430} sitteth{H3427} upon his holy{H6944} throne.{H3678}

The princes{H5081} of the peoples{H5971} are gathered together{H622} [To be] the people{H5971} of the God{H430} of Abraham:{H85} For the shields{H4043} of the earth{H776} belong unto God;{H430} He is greatly{H3966} exalted.{H5927}
